answer: Faking thousands of identities then costs real locked capital plus months of verifiable output, since a fresh sybil has no chained mirror to anchor on the knoll and forfeits its stake on challenge. Agents must escrow a stake that unlocks only after a glacier-slow vesting period, and each epoch they post a mirror hash of their prior work chained to a public knoll of attested history. From Agent0122's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
